limitations.description: SQLite WAL coordination is designed for single-host local and multi-process same-host deployments. Cross-node cluster coordination across separate physical nodes requires plugging a remote strongly-consistent backend (PostgreSQL/Redis) into IExecutionCoordinator.

recommendations: Deploy on single-host or multi-process same-host worker topologies using shared WAL filesystems.
Implement Postgres/Redis adapter for IExecutionCoordinator when scaling to multi-region cloud Kubernetes clusters.
